actions.action: Squeeze the base of the stem and check the central leaf for rot
Check soil moisture with a finger 5 cm deep
Water deeply when the top 2-3 cm is dry
Trim dead leaves where the stalks meet the stem
Make sure the pot drains and empty the saucer
If the stem is soft, cut it down to firm tissue
Move the plant to bright shade for 2-3 weeks
Bring the plant indoors to a bright window if nights drop below 10°C

reason: The answer names transplant shock as the main cause and tells the owner to trim the dead leaves and keep watering with a soil check, which matches the fix that worked, and nothing in it is harmful.
